create_WalkerPose: create a WalkerPose namedtuple with joint positions, Cartesian displacement, and quaternion orientation
build_Walker_subclass: build a Walker subclass that implements root_body and observable_joints abstract properties
transform_vec_to_egocentric_frame: transform a world-frame vector into the walker's egocentric frame using physics
apply_action_to_actuators: apply an action array to the walker's actuators via physics binding
collect_kinematic_sensors: collect kinematic sensor observables including gyro, accelerometer, and framequat from walker attachments
